## 📝 阅读笔记与高亮

### 🔴 核心论点 (结论/主要创新点)


> we propose to maximize the minimum achievable rate among multiple users for MAaided multiuser uplink transmissions by joint optimization of the MAs’ positions, their receive combining at the BS, and the transmit power of users, subject to the MAs’ positionsrelated constraints and the maximum transmit power of each user. (p. 19744)




> joint optimization of the MAs’ positions, their receive combining at the BS, and the transmit power of users, (p. 19744)




![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x31-y590.png>)


- 💡 **批注**: 系统模型：
这里的K个用户就相当于是K歌path

多个单天线用户同时上行发送，BS 端有 MM 根可移动天线。
优化目标：数字接收权重 W 和用户发射功率 P，还有每一个天线的位置\tilde{\mathbf r}

BS 根据 CSI / 当前干扰情况
        ↓
计算每个用户应该发多少功率 p_k
        ↓
通过控制信令告诉各个用户
        ↓
User k 调整自己的功率放大器
        ↓
再进行 uplink transmission



![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x47-y110.png>)


- 💡 **批注**: 注意到这里的W的尺寸就是设计了多波束，这里的K就是多个波束/用户每一个拥有一个权重矢量

这里设计了P的原因是之后要进行功率约束，如果我后续不管发射功率的话不需要考虑这个



![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x340-y506.png>)


- 💡 **批注**: 多用户+ 多径 multiuser multipath uplink



![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x315-y414.png>)


- 💡 **批注**: 注意 和导向矢量的区别 
steering vector ：沿着天线维度，固定 path，看所有 MAs 

field-response vector ：固定 MA，看所有 paths



![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x396-y365.png>)


- 💡 **批注**: 这里gk就是每一个path上面的complex gain



![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-4-x312-y105.png>)




![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-5-x130-y700.png>)




![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-5-x46-y494.png>)




> Moreover, the minimum achievable rate of all users increases from 1.44 bits per second per hertz (bps/Hz) to 2.36 bps/Hz, and yields about 63% performance improvement, which confirms the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm for obtaining feasible solutions and improving multiuser communication performance. (p. 19753)


- 💡 **批注**: rate的增长范围大概是60%以上就可以卸载试验结果里面当作是很好的性能结果，仿照他的写法。



> During the iterations, on one hand, it can be observed that the normalized signal power increases from 4 dB to 6.7 dB. It indicates that APV optimization can leverage the spatial (p. 19753)




![](<obsidian note/Paper Reading Assets/assets/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024/xiaoMultiuserCommunicationsMovableAntenna2024-11-x44-y535.png>)




> DoFs, which is beneficial for obtaining higher channel power gain. On the other hand, the normalized interference power decreases from −4 dB to −8.1 dB, which validates that the proposed algorithm can decrease the correlation of the channel vectors and mitigate interference among multiple users. The results reveal that the proposed algorithm for the MA-aided multiuser communication system can effectively enhance rate performance via channel gain improvement and multiuser interference suppression. (p. 19754)


- 💡 **批注**: 文中使用的PSO算法本身几乎没有可解释性，它就是一个黑盒式全局搜索器。这篇论文里MA 提升 channel gain、降低 correlation”这件事，<b>不是作者显式塞进 PSO 目标函数里的</b>，而是优化 max-min rate 之后出现的结果，再通过 Fig. 4 / Fig. 5 做事后解释。



> Furthermore, APV optimization tends to enable two users with approximately equal channel gains to guarantee their max-min fairness. In addition, the normalized channel crosscorrelation between user 1 and user 2 decreases from 0.1461 to 0.0518. The channel correlation is significantly reduced by APV optimization, thus suppressing multiuser interference. (p. 19754)


- 💡 **批注**: MA position optimization 一方面提高 channel power gain，另一方面降低不同用户 channel 的 correlation，从而抑制 multiuser interference



> y joint optimization of the MAs’ positions, their receive combining at the BS, and the transmit power of users, s (p. 1)

> DoFs, which is beneficial for obtaining higher channel power gain. On the other hand, the normalized interference power decreases from −4 dB to −8.1 dB, which validates that the proposed algorithm can decrease the correlation of the channel vectors and mitigate interference among multiple users. The results reveal that the proposed algorithm for the MA-aided multiuser communication system can effectively enhance rate performance via channel gain improvement and multiuser interference suppression. (p. 19754)


- 💡 **批注**: 文中使用的PSO算法本身几乎没有可解释性，它就是一个黑盒式全局搜索器。这篇论文里MA 提升 channel gain、降低 correlation”这件事，<b>不是作者显式塞进 PSO 目标函数里的</b>，而是优化 max-min rate 之后出现的结果，再通过 Fig. 4 / Fig. 5 做事后解释。



> Furthermore, APV optimization tends to enable two users with approximately equal channel gains to guarantee their max-min fairness. In addition, the normalized channel crosscorrelation between user 1 and user 2 decreases from 0.1461 to 0.0518. The channel correlation is significantly reduced by APV optimization, thus suppressing multiuser interference. (p. 19754)


- 💡 **批注**: MA position optimization 一方面提高 channel power gain，另一方面降低不同用户 channel 的 correlation，从而抑制 multiuser interference



> y joint optimization of the MAs’ positions, their receive combining at the BS, and the transmit power of users, s (p. 1)
